text:
Ravi: Posting follow-ups from yesterday's postmortem. We identified three action buckets: scheduler policy, quota guardrails, and headroom visibility. Need owners + short timelines.
Jules: I'll take scheduler policy changes. Immediate plan: add a priorityClass for short-lived batch jobs, reduce preemption window for large jobs, and add a soft queue for embeddings. Trying to land a canary in staging tomorrow.
Priya: I'll run the quota play with cloud ops & finance. Two asks: temporary emergency bump for next 2 weeks, and a longer term +15% reserved commit. Filing ticket now.
Ana: I'll update the incident runbook and oncall script with steps to triage capacity alerts and quick-reserve steps. Also adding a checklist for rolling back scheduler changes.
Jules: Draft scheduler snippet (staging):
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:\n  name: embeddings-batch
spec:\n  priorityClassName: batch-short
  tolerations: []\n  resources:\n    limits:\n      nvidia.com/gpu: 1
```
Jules: Priority class definitions will deprioritize long jobs during burst. We'll validate with load test.
Ravi: Can we also add a soft quota per-team to avoid runaway nightly jobs? Maybe a throttling admission controller rule.
Priya: Admission controller changes need product sign-off; in parallel I'll ask the jobs team to add a scheduling tag to heavy embeddings (tag: schedule_window=offpeak).
capacity-bot: Ticket created: https://redwood.local/tickets/INC-4421 (quota temporary bump), https://redwood.local/tickets/TASK-9240 (scheduler canary).
Ana: Observability request: expose pool_headroom_percent and preemptible_count in Console. That gives SRE quick visibility. Also add a 15min alert if headroom drops <10% for 2 consecutive windows.
Jules: Will add metrics (2026-04-05) and wire alert (2026-04-06).
Ravi: Timeline recap: Jules - scheduler canary in staging (2026-03-30), load test & promote to canary region (2026-04-01). Priya - temp quota bump request (2026-03-29), long-term quota commit (2026-04-10). Ana - runbook + alerts (2026-03-28).
Priya: Note: finance asked for business justification; I'll attach recent p99 latency/regression examples.
Ravi: Also adding one extra item: run a 72h simulated surge over a weekend to validate preemption behavior. Who can schedule?
Jules: I can coordinate the surge sim. Will aim for weekend 2026-04-04. Need oncall + capacity oncall present.
Ana: I'll create a post-sim checklist to capture failures and runbook gaps.
Priya: If quota bump stalls, we fallback to temporary routing policy: redirect non-critical traffic to lower-cost model variants for 48h.
Ravi: Good. Please add all blockers here. If none, I'll update the action tracker and set a 10m closure check for 2026-04-07.
Jules: :thumbsup: starting the staging canary config now.
capacity-bot: Action tracker updated: INC-4421, TASK-9240, TASK-9241 (runbook update), TASK-9242 (surge sim).
Ana: Adding weekly 10m remediation stand to calendar for the next 6 weeks.
Ravi: Closing: escalate to capacity oncall if we see >2 headroom alerts in 24h after these changes. Thanks everyone.
